While some people find it abstract, I see patterns everywhere. It's a tool I rely on for understanding the world, even if I don't always use advanced concepts in daily life.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Sometimes, yes. I worry about making mistakes or forgetting formulas. But since I like it, I try to stay calm. My anxiety isn't high, but when facing tough problems, I feel a bit of pressure. I remind myself to take a deep breath and focus on the steps instead of the outcome.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI tools to check my homework. It helped clarify confusing concepts and offered different ways to solve problems. I found it useful for quick explanations, though I still prefer learning on my own. It's a good supplement, but I don't rely on it for everything.
